children: still evaluating implications: Official Our Bureau Mumbai: State Bank of India (SBI) will recover costs and could generate surplus revenue from the new merchant discount rate (MDR) charges from October 15 because it is a large issuing bank and also has a payment gateway and a presence in united payment interface (UPI) applications a senior bank official said. "Naturally as one of the largest card issuing banks we will get 40 basis points of the value.

Then we also have a payments rail road on the UPI network which is not as famous a Gpay or Phone Pay but still formidable. We also have a application which has many customers on board. All this means that we will make a surplus but we have not yet done the calculations," the official said. From October 15, 2026, UPI payments above 2,000 will attract a MDR of 0.4%. This is the first time MDR has been charged on the hugely successful UPI payments since 2020.

The charges are likely to be split between the issuing bank, acquiring bank, payment gateways and UPI applications like GPay and PhonePay. Issuing bank whose debit or credit card is used is likely to receive 0.40% of the fee, acquiring bank in which account the amount is credited will receive 0.30%, payment gateways 0.20% and application services 0.10%. "Since we are both a large acquiring and issuing bank we will automatically get a large chunk of the amount. We also have a payment system and an application services so it is fair to assume that we will make some money though we have not done the calculations," the official said.

SBI is still evaluating the MDR implications. "There are also reports that people will split the transactions to avoid charges which means our volumes will increase but our value will not increase and it will create pressure on our systems. So we have to evaluate all those aspects," the official said. Replying to another question he said SBI has garnered $10 billion from FCNR (B) inflows which it is confident of deploying.

title: SBI Sees UPI MDR Gains from Presence Across Ecosystem
